description.zh: 通过电催化将火星大气 CO₂ 转化为浓缩的甲酸／甲酸盐原料，为下游工程细胞提供可利用的碳源。
description.en: Electrocatalysis converts Martian atmospheric CO₂ into concentrated formate/formic acid feedstock for downstream engineered cells.

description.zh: 连接电催化与生物同化的一碳原料，经还原甘氨酸途径进入工程大肠杆菌的中心代谢。
description.en: A one-carbon feedstock connecting electrocatalysis with biological assimilation through the reductive glycine pathway in engineered E. coli.

description.zh: 氨作为工程细胞的受控氮源输入。平台同时评估利用火星大气 N₂ 制取 NH₃ 的长期氮源供给模块。
description.en: Ammonia is supplied as a controlled nitrogen input for the engineered cells. The platform also evaluates conversion of Martian atmospheric N₂ to NH₃ as a long-term nitrogen-supply module.

label.zh: 工程大肠杆菌营养合成

description.zh: 工程大肠杆菌携带还原甘氨酸途径，将甲酸来源的一碳单元导入中心代谢。设计包含 ftfL、fchA、mtdA、GCS（GcvTHP）与 H-protein 工程；通过 pflB 敲除减少碳流损失、gcvR 敲除解除 GCS 抑制，并以 sdaA 支持丝氨酸至丙酮酸转化。碳流分配用于单细胞蛋白与氨基酸积累，以及含 SmPePD 的功能营养支路。
description.en: Engineered E. coli carries the reductive glycine pathway to channel formate-derived one-carbon units into central metabolism. The design includes ftfL, fchA, mtdA, GCS (GcvTHP) and H-protein engineering. A pflB knockout reduces carbon loss, a gcvR knockout relieves GCS repression, and sdaA supports serine-to-pyruvate conversion. Carbon allocation supports single-cell protein and amino acid accumulation, alongside a functional-nutrition branch involving SmPePD.

description.zh: 工程大肠杆菌同化一碳底物后积累单细胞蛋白和氨基酸，构成 Air2Protein 的基础营养输出，面向火星原位食物制造。
description.en: Single-cell protein and amino acids accumulate as engineered E. coli assimilates one-carbon feedstock, forming Air2Protein's basic nutritional output for in-situ food production on Mars.

description.zh: 功能营养支路由 β-丙氨酸与组氨酸通向 L-肌肽生产，与基础蛋白生产形成并行的营养输出。
description.en: The functional-nutrition branch directs β-alanine and histidine toward L-carnosine production, providing a nutritional output alongside basic protein production.
